paper_title: AI Scientists Fail Without Strong Implementation Capability
caption: Analysis of AI Scientist publications on arXiv. The upper panel displays the average number of citations up to now, categorized by containing implementation details. The lower panel shows the growth in the total number of these papers with the same categorization.

Here's a paragraph describing the line plot, following your guidelines:

This plot illustrates the change in average number of citations over time, categorized by whether the paper includes implementation details. The x-axis is labeled "Season", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 3 and tick labels representing “Fall ‘24”, “Winter ‘24”, and “Spring ‘25”. The y-axis is labeled "Quantity", using a linear scale ranging from 0 to 24. A blue solid line with circular markers represents the data for papers “Without Implementation,” starting at 10 citations at “Fall ‘24”, declining to 7 citations at “Winter ‘24”, and increasing to 21 citations at “Spring ‘25”. An orange dashed line with square markers represents the data for papers “With Implementation,” beginning at 2 citations at “Fall ‘24”, increasing to 7 citations at “Winter ‘24”, and reaching 13 citations at “Spring ‘25”.
